Priya — thanks for the quick turnaround. We went through the DPA and produced a redline PDF with a handful of commercial and data-transfer edits (attached). High-level questions we flagged:

1) Retention: We asked to shorten logs retention to 90 days by default (PayBridge policy). Can you confirm whether Redwood can configure per-customer retention windows or if logs are retained at platform-level?

2) KMS / key custody: We requested language allowing PayBridge to bring your own KMS for customer keys (BYOK) for encryption of at-rest backups. Is BYOK supported for the storage path?

3) Evidence: Please provide SOC 2 Type II report and latest pen test summary or secure link.

We prefer DocuSign; attached is PayBridge_DPA_redline.pdf. If these changes are not acceptable, let's flag the ones you want to take to legal. Would appreciate a response today if possible — procurement is trying to meet an internal cut-off next week.

Thanks,
Mark

Mark — thanks for the redline, appreciate the clear asks. Quick answers and a proposed path forward:

- Retention: Redwood's hosted logs retention is configurable at the customer level for application logs and KV cache artifacts; platform-level telemetry has longer retention for operations. We can offer a 90-day retention profile for PayBridge's customer data and logs for the Redwood API surface. We'll capture the retention profile in the order form/addendum.

- BYOK / KMS: For Hosted (Redwood API) we currently support customer-managed keys for model payload encryption in transit and at-rest via integrations with major cloud KMS providers (BYOK for backups requires Dedicated or Private deployments in our standard offering). We can propose language that allows PayBridge to use BYOK for encryption of sensitive backups if you commit to Dedicated capacity, or we can provide additional contractual safeguards for Hosted.

- Evidence: SOC 2 Type II and the latest pen-test summary are available here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-security (access granted to paybridge@paybridge.com). If you prefer an emailed copy we can generate a sealed link.

We reviewed your redline and have three items our legal team would like to discuss (minor commercial clarifications + transfer language around SCCs). Proposed next steps:
1) Karthik will consolidate our suggested counter-redlines and share them by EOD tomorrow.
2) Hannah will schedule a 30-minute call with PayBridge legal to walk the two transfer/retention items.
3) Once aligned, we will issue a DocuSign envelope — draft link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=demo&acct=12345&v1=paybridge (final envelope will include the executed DPA PDF).

If you want the BYOK path earlier, happy to connect infra/product leads; otherwise the Dedicated/Private option is the clearest technical route.

Priya/Hannah — I left this with you to coordinate signatures and the meeting invite.
